C A p:a p:b=1 s:n=0
  div.card#main c="x" title="{a} items"
    p "a & b <c> {n}"
C A p:xs
  ul
    *xs as x k=x.id
      li
        ?x.on
          b "{x.t}"
        :
          i "{x.t}"
i P ./P
C A p:xs
  P title="t"
    slot head
      span "h"
    *xs as x k=x
      p "{x}"
C A s:q=""
  form @submit=go
    input val=q @input=q=e.target.value ph="search"
    button type="submit" disabled "go"
C Oops catch p:title="broke"
  section
    h2 "{title}"
    p "{error.message}"
    button @click=reset "retry"
S T persist s:items=[]
  memo n = items.length
  cb add(x) = items=[...items,x]
C A p:style p:cls
  div style="color: {style}; --x: 1px" c=cls
    svg viewbox="0 0 2 2"
      path d="M0 0" strokewidth=2
js const Tag = "em"
C A p:n
  p
    "count:"
    "{n} of 10"
i { motion } from framer-motion
C A
  motion.div.sheet animate={opacity:1}
    p "x"
C A p:rest
  input ...rest tabindex=0 readonly
C A p:a
  {a}
C A
  my-widget.big text="x"
C A p:Tag p:rows
  {Tag} c="row" ...rest
    *rows as r k=r.id
      {Tag} "{r.t}"
C A p:big p:rows p:f
  .card as={big ? "section" : "div"}
    "one"
    "two"
  *rows as r k=r.id
    {f(r, null, 1)} c="x" "{r.t}"
C A p:as
  {as}
    slot head
      p "h"
    "text"
    p "a < b"
C A s:as="div"
  .nav as=Link to="/" "home"
  button @click=as="section" "swap"
  {as} class="x" tabindex=0 "hi"
C A s:open=false
  button @click=open=true "open"
  ?open
    portal
      .scrim @click=open=false
        .card @click=e.stopPropagation()
          h2 "hi"
          {children}
C A p:rows p:to
  main
    portal {to}
      p "a < b"
    *rows as r k=r.id
      portal "#overlay"
        p "{r.t}"
